## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Police stops, move over law, traffic signals and basic sign shapes

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A02
A flashing circular red light requires a full stop like a stop sign, while a flashing yellow light requires only slowing, scanning and yielding before proceeding [A02].
Why it matters: group flashing signals; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F15; confusables sec05-F15, sec05-F16
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A02
A solid green arrow protects the left turn because oncoming traffic has red, whereas a flashing yellow arrow permits the turn only after yielding to oncoming traffic that has green [A02].
Why it matters: group turn arrows; difficulty high; prereq sec05-F20; confusables sec05-F20, sec05-F19
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
A stopped emergency vehicle calls for slowing down everywhere, but the additional duty to change lanes applies only on a four lane highway and only when the change is safe [A01].
Why it matters: group move over law; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F05; confusables sec05-F06, sec05-F05
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
An approaching emergency vehicle requires you to pull right and stop until it passes, while a stopped one requires caution, slowing and where possible a lane change rather than a stop [A01].
Why it matters: group move over law; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F05; confusables sec05-F05, sec05-F06
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A01
A dark traffic signal is treated as a stop sign for every direction, while a signal flashing red or yellow is obeyed as that flashing color [A01].
Why it matters: group signal failures; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F09; confusables sec05-F09, sec05-F15
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0032]
